premise: Bee is so tired her hum goes quiet; Butterfly and Mushroom hum her song for her while she rests (Mushroom's first try ends in a sneeze), and in the morning all three hum together.
inspiration: Aesop's The Ant and the Grasshopper, turned: the singers do not scold the worker; they carry her song while she rests.
lesson: Friends carry each other when one is tired.

en-US.title: Bee Loses Her Hum
en-US.text: {bee:float loop 0.3} Every day, {bee:enter} Bee buzzed over the meadow, humming while she worked. Hmm-hmm-bzzz. It was the sound of the whole meadow. {canvas:sunset 0.6 26s} {sfx:evening} But one evening, Bee was so tired that her hum went quiet. {bee:face sad} [sad] She tried… and only a tiny bz came out. {butterfly:enter} Butterfly fluttered down. {butterfly:face surprised} The meadow is too quiet! Beside her, a little {mushroom:enter} mushroom popped up. [curious] Can you hum, Mushroom? Mushroom tried. Mmmm… but the hum tickled. {mushroom:live} Ah… ah… {sfx:sneeze} ACHOO! Out came a puff of glitter. {bee:face happy} Bee smiled a sleepy smile. {butterfly:face happy} [softly] So Mushroom hummed, and Butterfly {butterfly:live hold} folded her wings and hummed too. Hmm-hmm-bzzz, slow and sleepy, {bee:face sleeping} while Bee rested. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 16s} In the morning, Butterfly {butterfly:live resume} opened her wings and fluttered. {bee:face happy} Bee woke up bright. {bee:live} She took a deep breath, closed her eyes and hummed… then waggled a little dance. [happily] And this time, {mushroom:face happy} {mushroom:hearts} {butterfly:hearts} all three hummed together.

es-ES.title: Abeja pierde su zumbido
es-ES.text: {bee:float loop 0.3} Todos los días, {bee:enter} Abeja zumbaba por el prado mientras trabajaba. Mm-mm-bzzz. Era el sonido de todo el prado. {canvas:sunset 0.6 26s} {sfx:evening} Pero una tarde, Abeja estaba tan cansada que su zumbido se apagó. {bee:face sad} [sad] Lo intentó… y solo le salió un bz chiquitito. {butterfly:enter} Mariposa bajó revoloteando. {butterfly:face surprised} ¡El prado está demasiado callado! A su lado brotó una {mushroom:enter} seta pequeñita. [curious] Seta, ¿tú sabes zumbar? Seta lo intentó. Mmmm… pero el zumbido le hizo cosquillas. {mushroom:live} Aaa… aaa… {sfx:sneeze} ¡ACHÍS! Salió un soplo de purpurina. {bee:face happy} Abeja sonrió, medio dormida. {butterfly:face happy} [softly] Así que Seta zumbó, y Mariposa {butterfly:live hold} juntó las alas y zumbó también. Mm-mm-bzzz, lento y dormilón, {bee:face sleeping} mientras Abeja descansaba. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 16s} Por la mañana, Mariposa {butterfly:live resume} abrió las alas y revoloteó. {bee:face happy} Abeja se despertó llena de energía. {bee:live} Respiró hondo, cerró los ojos y zumbó… y luego se marcó un bailecito, meneándose. [happily] Y esta vez, {mushroom:face happy} {mushroom:hearts} {butterfly:hearts} zumbaron las tres juntas.

evening.prompt: a calm evening meadow, very soft distant insects and a light breeze

sneeze.prompt: a tiny, cute, high-pitched sneeze with a soft sparkly puff
